input: Enroll in a home barista espresso technique course

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in a Home Barista Espresso Course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enroll in a course focused on espresso techniques for home baristas.

questions.title: Do you prefer an online course or in-person class?
questions.description: Understanding the format preference helps narrow down the right course options.

questions.title: What espresso equipment do you currently own at home?
questions.description: Knowing the user's existing gear ensures the course content is compatible with what they have.

questions.title: How would you rate your current espresso skill level?
questions.description: Identifying whether they are a complete beginner, intermediate, or advanced learner helps target the right course level.

questions.title: What is your budget for this course?
questions.description: A budget range helps filter between free resources, affordable courses, and premium programs.

questions.title: Is there a specific skill you most want to master?
questions.description: Knowing a target skill such as dialing in grind, milk steaming, or latte art helps prioritize the right curriculum.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or target date to start?
questions.description: A timeline helps determine urgency and whether enrollment windows or course schedules need to be considered.

questions.title: Do you want a certificate upon completing the course?
questions.description: Some users want formal recognition while others only care about practical knowledge, which affects which platforms to prioritize.
